Before you ask.

How much does a full villa renovation cost in Dubai?

It depends on size and finish level. Most full villa renovations we deliver start from AED 200,000, with premium and luxury scopes going well beyond that. After a site visit you receive a detailed, fixed-scope quotation, never vague per-day pricing.

How long does it take?

A typical full villa renovation runs 8 to 16 weeks depending on scope and approvals. Your project manager gives you a timeline before work starts and weekly updates throughout.

Do you handle community and authority approvals?

Yes. Drawings, NOCs and permits are part of our scope. You don't chase developers or authorities yourself.

Can I live in my villa during the renovation?

For full villa renovations we recommend relocating temporarily. It's faster, safer and more comfortable, especially during structural and MEP works. Your project manager will advise based on your scope.

Do you take on small jobs like painting or single-room work?

No. We focus on full renovations only, which is how we keep dedicated crews and consistent quality on every project.

Is there a warranty?

Yes. Our workmanship is covered by warranty, and we return to resolve any snags after handover.
